chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar and Muhammad ibn Ismail from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Safwan ibn Yahya from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
In the Book of Ali (peace be upon him): 'In every month is an Umra'.

key_terms.كِتَابِ عَلِيٍّ: The Book of Ali (referring to a specific text attributed to Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: What does the Book of Imam Ali say about performing Umra in every month?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi highlights the virtue of frequent pilgrimage by citing a tradition attributed to Imam Ali (peace be upon him), stating that performing Umra in every month is recommended. In Shia scholarly tradition, this is often understood as emphasizing the spiritual benefits of regular devotion rather than a literal, obligatory requirement for every single month, reflecting the flexibility in Islamic jurisprudence regarding voluntary acts of worship.

en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjaj,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘In the Book of Ali<sup>asws</sup>: ‘In every month is an Umra’.
en.sarwar: 2. Abu Ali al-Ash’ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar and Muhammad ibn ‘Isma‘il has narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Safwan ibn Yahya from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
It is in the book of Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, that there is al-‘Umrah in every month.”’
